data.explanation: Your furnished apartment's fixed-term lease is set to end on 31 January 2027. The landlord offers to extend it by six or twelve months at the same rent, but you must tell them in writing by the stated date if you want this. If you don't reply, they will plan to hand the apartment back at the end of January, meaning you would need to move out. Decide whether you want to stay longer and reply in time; no action is needed if you already plan to move out.
